FIELDS.NAME: HomeTech Appliance Sales & Repair
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Inspection Coordinator, 1234 Appliance Way, Springfield, IL 62701-1234, (555) 123-4567
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
HomeTech Appliance Sales & Repair specializes in the retail sales and repair of household appliances. Our operations are based in a secure physical storefront, which houses a well-maintained inventory of appliances including refrigerators, washers, and dryers. We conduct less than 25% of our operations off-site, focusing on delivering quality service through professional installations and repairs at customer locations.

Safety and security are prioritized through an active, centrally monitored alarm system. Our staff are trained and certified in the latest manufacturer installation protocols, ensuring compliance with industry standards to reduce the risk of installation errors. We maintain organized inventory storage in a locked area with restricted access to prevent unauthorized access and theft.

HomeTech values operational excellence and customer satisfaction, maintaining up-to-date records of sales, repairs, and customer interactions through a digital management system. Our commitment to compliance extends to not engaging in any hazardous material disposal or recycling services without the necessary permits, ensuring we operate within legal and environmental standards.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any off-site operations exceeding 25% of total activities, including delivery, installation, or emergency repair services. We confirm that a centrally monitored alarm system is installed and fully operational, electrical system upgrades have been completed within the last five years and comply with current code standards, and all vehicles used in business operations have appropriate commercial auto insurance and liability limits in place.
